name: Nanjing Port Co., Ltd.
summary: Nanjing Port Co., Ltd. operates within the Chinese market, delivering a range of port and maritime services. The company's primary offerings include the transit and storage of various liquid commodities, specifically crude oil, refined petroleum products, and other liquid chemicals. It also provides customs-bonded warehousing solutions for petrochemicals and manages comprehensive, integrated logistics operations. Headquartered in Nanjing, China, Nanjing Port Co., Ltd. functions as a subsidiary under the larger Nanjing Port (Group) Co., Ltd.
